name: Clonazolam

tolerance.full: within a couple of days of continuous use

summary: A long lasting benzodiazepine with heavily hypnotic effects. The safety profile is not well established, and there have been reports that people taking it three days in a row have had a seizure. Most comparable to Triazolam, but with a much longer half-life.
metabolism: Evidence is from a peer-reviewed review of designer benzodiazepines (Edinoff et al., Neurol Int 2022, PMID 35997362). Clonazolam has a half-life of about 3.6 hours and is extensively metabolized, being mainly excreted as its amino and acetamino metabolites. The main metabolites are 7-aminoclonazolam, hydroxyclonazolam and 7-acetaminoclonazolam, all of which are eliminated in the urine. Its volume of distribution is reported as unknown.
